acceptance_criteria.criterion: Close the remaining enabled webhook signature, replay, completion, and redaction gaps.
evidence: Signature: app/api/webhooks/music-marketplace/[partner]/route.ts no longer has an unsigned path. An unconfigured secret is unconditionally 503, never a processing pass. Mutation M1 (the retired MUSIC_MARKETPLACE_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_UNSIGNED bypass restored) fails the case 'has no unsigned path: an unconfigured endpoint fails closed even with the unsigned flag set'. A valid signature over the raw body is accepted and a tampered body, a tampered signature header, and a body re-serialized after signing are each rejected, on both the partner and the royalty route.

Replay: a claim collision is no longer treated as the outcome on either route. resolveClaim reads the completion marker first: completed acknowledges with zero side effects, an incomplete claim past a bounded window is atomically reclaimed and RESUMES, and an unreadable marker or an unresolvable collision fails closed with 500. Mutation M2 (acknowledge-on-23505 restored in both routes) fails 4 cases; mutation M2c (incomplete-claim release removed) fails the mid-flight-retry case.

Completion: all three routes check the completion write. A write that errors OR lands on no row returns 5xx instead of acknowledging. Mutation M3 (verification removed from all three routes) fails 3 cases. A mid-flight failure returns 5xx, leaves no completion marker, and the retry resumes and completes exactly once on both the partner and royalty routes.

Redaction: redactCredentialMaterial replaces credential-bearing values before any provider payload reaches a durable row, while payload_hash still covers the raw signed body. Mutation M4 (raw payload persisted) fails 2 cases. No secret present in a request reaches a persisted row, a console.error argument, or a response body, on the happy path or on any error path exercised.

progress.summary: All four webhook gap families are closed with mutation proof (signature bypass removed, replay resolved from the completion marker, completion write verified, payloads redacted). The two handoffs this task accepted are not satisfied by this work and are re-pointed: the integrations type-drift cluster moves to INTG-010, and the CodeQL alert triage moves to RELEASE-013 because GitHub Advanced Security has no local engine and the remaining steps are owner-executed.
completed: Added path outside the declared working set, with reason: lib/integrations/webhook-security.ts gained redactCredentialMaterial, isCredentialKey, and REDACTED_MARKER. A credential-key vocabulary plus a bounded deep walk is domain logic, and copying it per route is the exact duplication this module exists to prevent. The change is purely additive; no existing export was modified.

app/api/webhooks/music-marketplace/[partner]/route.ts: removed the MUSIC_MARKETPLACE_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_UNSIGNED processing pass. An unconfigured secret is now unconditionally 503, mirroring the already-retired royalty behaviour and closing audit finding M5 on this route.

app/api/webhooks/music-marketplace/[partner]/route.ts: a claim collision is resolved by processing_status / processed_at instead of being acknowledged. A completed receipt acks with zero side effects; a failed or window-expired receipt is atomically reclaimed and resumes; an unreadable marker or unresolvable collision returns 500.

app/api/webhooks/music-marketplace/[partner]/route.ts: the completion update is guarded on processing_status = 'received', must return its row, and otherwise throws into the fail-closed path. Persisted receipt and subscription-event payloads are credential-redacted while payload_hash still covers the raw signed body.

app/api/webhooks/music-royalty-payouts/route.ts: the same completion-marker discipline, implemented on the ledger's real columns (processed_at, created_at) with a bounded reclaim, so no migration is required. A collision with no completion marker resumes instead of acknowledging; an unreadable marker returns 500. Every post-claim failure path releases the incomplete claim (guarded on processed_at is null) so the provider's retry is not answered as work that never happened. The completion write is checked and the provider payload is credential-redacted before it is written.

app/api/webhooks/supabase/notifications/route.ts, the only non-gated and therefore launch-enabled route in the working set: the completion write is now guarded on status = 'processing' and must return its row. An unpersisted completion returns 500 instead of acknowledging a delivery whose ledger state was never recorded.

lib/integrations/webhook-security.ts: added redactCredentialMaterial / isCredentialKey / REDACTED_MARKER, a non-mutating depth-bounded deep walk that replaces credential-bearing values using a case- and separator-insensitive vocabulary, so a webhook ledger row is never a durable copy of unauthenticated credential material. Additive only.

__tests__/integrations/webhook-launch-certification.test.ts (new, 23 cases): a stateful Supabase double enforces the real unique constraints and filter semantics, so the four families are asserted against persisted state rather than call counts. It covers both re-serialized-body rejections, the mid-flight-failure-then-resume-then-duplicate sequence, the unpersisted-completion 5xx on all three routes, and redaction assertions over persisted rows plus log arguments plus response bodies.

__tests__/integrations/webhook-security-primitives.test.ts: 4 new cases for the redaction helper, covering depth and key spelling, business fields left untouched, the input never being mutated, and depth truncation.

__tests__/integrations/webhook-route-inventory.test.ts: satisfied the completion_condition of HF-INTG-006-TICKETING-RESOLVED. The ticketing/webhook/route.ts entry moves from 'verified' with an open completion-marker gap to 'hardened' and cites 20260926130000_ticketing_webhook_completion_marker.sql. The three routes changed here also have their posture and note updated.

__tests__/integrations/webhook-route-behavior.test.ts: the notifications happy path and the shared partner duplicate case now stub the completion and marker SELECT, so each case can distinguish a persisted completion from a silently lost one. No expectation was weakened; the duplicate case previously passed vacuously because the marker read returned nothing.

app/api/webhooks/music-royalty-payouts/__tests__/route.test.ts: replaced the ad-hoc two-level chain mock with a chainable stub, made the duplicate case stub a completed receipt instead of only a collision error, and added a fail-closed case for an unresolvable collision.
